Maya: Quick shoutout — huge thanks to @Sofia and @Allen for jumping on the model routing flake and getting the demo back up in 20 min. 🙏🔥
Sofia: oh wow, didn't realize it was that visible. Allen and I paired; CS pinged us, thx for flagging @Tia.
Allen: team effort — SRE ran the hotfix, ML infra swapped fallback model. Commands we ran:
```
./scripts/route-fallback --model v2 --priority real-time
kubectl rollout restart svc/inference-router
```
Jon: that was slick. Saved the demo — applause :clap: 
Tia: ❤️ big win. Adding this to the retro notes under 'wins' and pinging PMs.
Customer Success Bot: New ticket linked -> #INC-8842 (customer reported degraded responses)
Maya: also, major props to @Sofia for staying calm and for the clear debug steps. Please DM me if you want swag / gift card.
Sofia: haha, no swag needed, but coffee gift card accepted :coffee: — thanks everyone!
Allen: +1 on coffee. Also leaving a short runbook snippet in docs/infra/incident-templates
Jon: can someone drop the runbook link here?
Allen: here: https://redwood.internal/infra/runbooks/model-routing
Tia: saved. I'll mention at stand and add a :trophy: in #all-hands shoutouts for this week.
Maya: love it. ok back to product stuff — but can't overstate how smooth that was. :sparkles:
deploy-bot: deploy completed by @Allen 1912345705 — rollout success :rocket:
Jon: :party-parrot:
